functionalReqs: Stream a live event to all viewers with low delay
Users submit answers or picks that change their score
Show a global top-100 and each user's own rank
Live score updates pushed to viewers
hints: How do you get one video stream to 25M people without your servers sending 25M copies?
A sorted set gives rank in O(log n). What happens when 1M updates/s hit one Redis key?

Ingest → transcode into HLS segments at several bitrates → multi-CDN; pre-scale before the event; leaderboard via sharded Redis sorted sets with periodic merge of shard top-k for the global top-100 and approximate rank for everyone else; score updates through a queue; push top-100 snapshots via WebSocket or polling with CDN-cached JSON.
nonFunctionalReqs: Survives a sudden spike to 25M+ concurrent viewers
Leaderboard updates within a few seconds
problemStatement:
Design a **live sports streaming** platform (like Hotstar during a cricket final) that also shows a **real-time leaderboard** for a fantasy or quiz game played alongside the match.

Tens of millions of viewers join within minutes; the leaderboard updates every few seconds for everyone.
title: Design Live Streaming with a Real-time Leaderboard
